effect.name: Bubble Content Mask (Background)
effect.description: This shader should be applied over the Bubble Mask (Texture) layer, the color will be masked based on the layer underneath.
effect.author: Foxioo (Made at JayTholen's request)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Bubble Content Mask (Background) Shader | 1.1 (02.03.2026) */
parameter.description: This shader should be applied over the Bubble Mask (Texture) layer, the color will be masked based on the layer underneath.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Color Inner
parameter.description: This variable determines the color from the mask, i.e. if the color matches, the mask will be visible.

parameter.name: Background Color
parameter.description: The variable defines the background color visible in the content mask.

parameter.name: Outline Color
parameter.description: The variable defines the red, green and blue color of the outline.

parameter.name: Outline Alpha
parameter.description: The variable defines the alpha color of the outline.

parameter.name: Outline Offset
parameter.description: The variable defines the size of the outline.

parameter.name: Outline Corner
parameter.description: Determines whether the outline is 4-way or 8-way.
